response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack and systems engineer, but the profile is a poor match for this role. Professional C++ experience is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evident SQL Server or Oracle depth, and no Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience — RIDE Capital was a retail investment-structuring startup, not capital markets. While low-latency work at Dunnhumby and CI/CD skills are attractive, the core mandatory requirements are unmet.
strengths: Proven low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, and open-source contributions
Broad polyglot background (C/C++, D, Java, TypeScript) with strong communication and teaching record
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, and nearly a decade ago
No Fixed Income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development depth

key_factors.factor: Missing capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and low-latency systems background
